notes.title: Stability Patch - January 18th
notes.notes:
Hello Technicians!

We've deployed a patch to fix some common stability issues. Please update your game to the latest version for these fixes to take effect!

[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]Updates to backend game systems to prevent common crashes.
[*]Level Loading has been updated to make it smoother for more players.
[*]The Fans in Level 3 has had changes made relating to player locomotion. This should give you a much smoother experience while moving and while stationary on the blades!
[*]Various minor visual fixes
[/list]

Should you encounter any more bugs, please report them in our [url=https://discord.gg/GYy8VY9hpY]Discord Server.[/url] 

- Tuna Melt Media
